init_splats 128->256: worse — more starting capacity doesn't help within 1500 steps; 6 discards in a row on hyperparameter nudges, pivoting to structural changes
densify=False (fixed num_splats=384, no growth-event disturbance): worse — confirms adaptive densification is genuinely earning its keep on this scene, not just noise

metric: FINAL CONFIRMATION at real target budget (steps=4000, resolution=120 — no CLI overrides, deterministic XLA ops): original defaults (init_v_scale=0.1, weight_decay=0.1, lr=3e-3) give rel_RMS=0.10245 (num_params=4088); kept config (init_v_scale=0.3, weight_decay=0.02, lr=1e-2) gives rel_RMS=0.09595 (num_params=4048) — 6.3% relative improvement, smaller than the 16.9% seen at the 1500-step proxy budget used during search. lr=1e-2 was tuned for the short proxy budget and its marginal benefit shrinks (but stays positive) at 4000 steps — a budget-matched follow-up sweep of lr specifically at steps=4000 is the natural next experiment.
